claims.statement: For any finite family of scopes (S_i) over finite variable domains (D_v), a locally permitted assignment family glues to a unique assignment on union_i S_i iff every pair agrees on S_i intersect S_j, and when union_i S_i = V restriction and gluing form mutual-inverse bijections between global solutions and pairwise-compatible locally permitted families (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.gluing_iff_pairwise_compatible and compatible_permitted_bijection).
dependencies: Finite variable set V, declared finite domains D_v, and explicit allowed local relations R_i on scopes S_i.
Core Lean 4 theorems PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.gluing_iff_pairwise_compatible and compatible_permitted_bijection in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean (zero sorryAx, zero Classical.choice).
claims.limits: Applies to static finite scope families and declared value relations without hidden mutable state or side effects; uncovered variables require explicit unary domain scopes for uniqueness and nonemptiness on V.

claims.statement: Over Boolean variables (x, y, z) in {0, 1}^3 on scopes (x, y), (y, z), (z, x), the local constraints x = y, y = z, and z != x each have cardinality 2 yet admit zero common global solutions across all 8 triples, whereas replacing z != x with z = x yields exactly {(0, 0, 0), (1, 1, 1)} (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.boolean_cycle_obstruction_and_equality_solutions and verified in code/replay.py).
dependencies: Boolean carrier D = {0, 1} and binary relations EQ = {(0,0),(1,1)}, NE = {(0,1),(1,0)} on the 3-cycle.
Core Lean 4 theorem PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.boolean_cycle_obstruction_and_equality_solutions in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean.
claims.limits: Finite 3-variable Boolean parity/equality cycle witness only; makes no quantum-contextuality or stochastic agent-reliability claim.

claims.limits: Deterministic standard-library replay of the 3-variable Boolean fixture only; zero model calls and zero authority effect.

claims.statement: On any finite deterministic partial action table with positive rational step costs, terminal labels, and protected initial report q0, a report map q admits an exact quotient table iff states in each q-fibre share terminal labels, protected reports, and per-action enablement, enabled step cost, and successor q-fibre, in which case legal words, reports, accumulated word costs, and optimal resolution costs are preserved (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.exact_quotient_implies_fibre_compatible, fibre_compatible_gives_exact_quotient, exact_quotient_execWord_commutes, fibre_compatible_execWord_congr, and fibre_compatible_preserves_resolvesWithCost).
dependencies: Finite deterministic partial costed action table with exact rational costs on enabled transitions.
Core Lean 4 Section 1 theorems in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean (zero sorryAx, zero Classical.choice).
claims.limits: Deterministic partial tables only; nondeterministic, stochastic, or hidden-state transition systems require richer observation structures.

claims.statement: Iterative block splitting by disabled-or-(exact-cost, successor-block) action signatures over a finite nonempty state carrier X terminates after at most |X| - 1 proper splits at the unique coarsest stable refinement of q0 (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.stable_refines_all_iterSplit, stabilized_iterSplit_is_coarsest_stable, proper_splits_le_pred_card, and distinctColorCount_le_length, and verified in code/replay.py::refine).
dependencies: Strict block-count ascent 1 <= b_0 < b_1 < ... < b_m <= |X| on proper splits and monotone signature refinement.
Core Lean 4 Section 2 theorems in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean.
claims.limits: Requires an explicitly supplied finite state/action/cost table; does not certify heuristic text-summary projections.

claims.statement: On the three-state costed table {a, b, t} with initial report q0(a) = q0(b) = 0, q0(t) = 1 and finish transitions a -> t (cost 1) and b -> t (cost 3), identifying {a, b} preserves current output 0 but violates fibre cost agreement (1 != 3) and alters resolution cost (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.output_preserving_collapse_breaks_cost and verified in code/replay.py).
dependencies: Core Lean 4 theorem PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.output_preserving_collapse_breaks_cost in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean.
claims.limits: Finite 3-state counterexample separating current-output equivalence from future operating-cost equivalence.

claims.statement: Under strictly positive transition costs on a finite deterministic partial table X, erasing any nonempty repeated-state cycle strictly lowers both word length and total cost, so whenever a resolving word exists the minimum resolution cost is attained by a simple path of at most |X| - 1 transitions; in Paper 016's three-state table {r, s, t}, ('next', 'finish') achieves optimal cost 2 against ('direct',) at cost 5 and ('loop', 'next', 'finish') at cost 3 (mechanized in PFP.FunnelCompressionClosure.loop_erasure_strictly_reduces_cost and paper016_route_example_costs).
dependencies: Strictly positive step costs c_a(x) > 0 on every enabled transition and finite state set X.
Core Lean 4 Section 3 theorems in lean4/FunnelCompressionClosure.lean.
claims.limits: Strict positivity c_a(x) > 0 is required for strict cycle-cost reduction; zero-cost cycles allow tied non-simple optima and negative-cost cycles prevent finite minimum attainment.
